recipe.visualDefinition: A tight macro shot of a human mouth buried in dark, moist soil, with a single white daisy held between the teeth. The composition is centered and claustrophobic, emphasizing the texture of the earth and the contrast between the organic decay of the soil and the life of the flower.
coreVisualRelationships: The mouth acts as a central organic portal within the dark soil
The white daisy provides a singular point of high-contrast light
The rough texture of the mulch and worms contrasts with the smooth enamel of the teeth
The warm skin tones of the lips bridge the gap between the dark earth and the bright flower
coreInvariants: Dark, rich, moist soil texture with visible mulch and earthworms
A human mouth slightly open to reveal a full set of teeth
A single daisy held in the corner of the mouth
Top-left alignment for primary text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mouth is centrally located, occupying the middle third of the frame horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white daisy on the right side of the mouth serves as the primary focal point due to its brightness.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright daisy, moves across the teeth to the left, then up to the text in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The surrounding dark soil acts as heavy, textured negative space that compresses the central subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal (soil) providing a dark, moody foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (teeth and daisy petals) creating sharp focal points.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre and muted gold (typography and daisy center) for warmth.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white elements and the black background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy browns, reds, and whites

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elongated, condensed sans-serif with irregular heights
letterConstructionRules: Rough, hand-drawn edges resembling scratched wood or bone
Inconsistent stroke widths with a vertical emphasis
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'H' and 'R' have extended vertical stems
The 'O' is narrow and slightly asymmetrical
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A primary tall, distressed display face paired with a smaller, cleaner block-style sans-serif for secondary info.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, organic feel of the soil and burial theme
Provides the necessary verticality and grit

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A macro photograph of dark, moist potting soil with visible wood chips and a few earthworms. In the center, a human mouth is visible as if buried, showing lips and teeth. A single white daisy with a yellow/brown center is tucked into the side of the mouth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom-lettered text in the top-left corner using a muted gold color. The main text should be tall and distressed; the secondary text should be a smaller, cleaner condensed sans-serif directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the soil texture sharp and detailed?
Does the daisy stand out as the brightest element?
Is the typography positioned in the top-left with a weathered texture?
Are the earthworms visible but subtle in the lower half?

mustRedesign: Avoid exact replication of the specific artist name
Ensure the worms do not look overly stylized or cartoonish
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic interaction between soil and skin
Ensure the daisy stem looks naturally held by the teeth
Verify the text color matches the earthy ochre tones
Confirm the composition feels claustrophobic and grounded
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro organic subject + dark textured environment + high-contrast floral accent + distressed vertical typography.
